# RNSIT Model United Nations Conference 2026 (RNSMUN 2026)

> Official website and delegate portal for RNSMUN 2026, the premier collegiate Model United Nations conference hosted by MUNSoc at RNS Institute of Technology (RNSIT), Bengaluru, Karnataka, India.

## Conference Overview
- **Event Name**: RNSIT Model United Nations Conference 2026 (RNSMUN 2026 / RNS MUN '26)
- **Conference Dates**: 06–07 October 2026 (Tuesday – Wednesday)
- **Host Institution**: RNS Institute of Technology (RNSIT), Dr. Vishnuvardhan Road, Channasandra, Rajarajeshwarinagar, Bengaluru, Karnataka - 560098
- **Organizer**: MUNSoc RNSIT (Model United Nations Society of RNSIT)
- **Official Website**: https://mun.rnsit.ac.in
- **Total Prize Pool**: ₹1,00,000+ INR across all committees and delegations
- **Best Delegation Trophy**: Flagship award of ₹10,000 INR cash prize and champion trophy for the top-performing college/school delegation

## Simulated Committees & Agendas
1. **UNSC (United Nations Security Council)**
   - *Agenda*: Addressing Parallel Governments and De Facto Authorities in Civil Wars: Sovereignty, Territorial Control and International Recognition.
   - *Focus*: Flashpoints in contested territories, diplomatic legitimacy, crisis de-escalation, international recognition frameworks.
2. **Lok Sabha (House of the People - Indian Parliament)**
   - *Agenda*: Deliberating the Reorganization of Parliamentary Constituencies with Special Emphasis on Delimitation, Demographic Shifts, and Inter-State Political Equilibrium.
   - *Focus*: Constitutional governance, federal representation, population dynamics, political equilibrium.
3. **DISEC (Disarmament and International Security Committee - UNGA 1)**
   - *Agenda*: Evaluating the Security Implications of Militarized Strategic Minerals in Conflict Zones: Critical Supply Chains and Arms Proliferation.
   - *Focus*: Strategic resource governance, arms proliferation, rare earth supply chain weaponization, peacekeeping mandates.
4. **UNHRC (United Nations Human Rights Council)**
   - *Agenda*: Assessing the Protection of Civilian Infrastructure in Armed Conflicts with Focus on Warfare and Rights of Displaced Populations.
   - *Focus*: International humanitarian law (IHL), safeguarding medical/water/energy grids, refugee protection, accountability.
5. **UNODC (United Nations Office on Drugs and Crime)**
   - *Agenda*: Combating Transnational Illicit Drug Cartels and Synthetic Narcotics Supply Chains with Emphasis on Dark Web Markets.
   - *Focus*: Maritime trafficking corridors, cryptocurrency laundering, synthetic opioids (fentanyl), global inter-agency enforcement.
6. **IP (International Press Corps)**
   - *Roles*: Investigative Journalists, Photojournalists, Caricaturists, and Beat Reporters covering real-time committee proceedings, press conferences, and crisis breaking news.

## Delegate Registration & Fee Tiers
- **Official Registration Portal**: https://mun.rnsit.ac.in/registration
- **Internal RNSIT Delegate Pass**: ₹999 INR (All-inclusive 2-day conference access, delegate kit, food & beverages, official certification)
- **External Delegate Pass (Early Bird - till September 18)**: ₹1,200 INR (Discounted 2-day access, delegate kit, lunch & refreshments, certificate)
- **External Delegate Pass (Standard - after September 18)**: ₹1,349 INR
- **Institutional Delegation (Group Registration)**:
  - Delegation Size: 9 to 25 delegates per group
  - Eligibility: Compete for the Flagship Best Delegation Trophy (₹10,000 & Trophy)
  - Features: Automated live Google Spreadsheet roster generation and bulk invoice accreditation
